g.text: At 40, the richest 1% of US men had a life expectancy 14.6 years longer than the poorest 1%; for women

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: the gap was 10.1 years. Life expectancy rose across the whole income range, with no plateau at the top.
